age.evidence: C57BL/6J adult male mice (Janvier, Le Genest-Saint-Isle, France)

sex.evidence: C57BL/6J adult male mice... A total of 10 mice were dosed orally with either 3 mg/kg bodyweight psilocybin (n = 5) or saline solution (n = 5)

dosing.evidence: A total of 10 mice were dosed orally with either 3 mg/kg bodyweight psilocybin (n = 5) or saline solution (n = 5).

group_housing.evidence: maintained in littermate pairs in standard cages

day_night_flipped.evidence: The colony room was on a reversed light-dark cycle (dark phase 07:00 to 19:00)

enrichment_housing.evidence: standard cages (containing sawdust, a sleeping chamber, tissue paper, and a wood stick)

judge_notes: This is a pharmacokinetics/metabolism study. Mice were dosed with psilocybin and blood was sampled at multiple timepoints for plasma analysis; no behavioural assays were conducted. Both candidates correctly returned an empty assays array.
All in vitro/ex vivo work (HLM, recombinant CYPs, MAO, UGT, 5-HT receptor binding/activation) is excluded per rubric.
Human plasma sample reanalysis is also non-behavioural and excluded.
